assertions.claim: Cut the power first, or push the wire off with a dry wooden stick, and only then touch the person.
assertions.cn_span: 先断电，或者用干燥的木棍之类把电源挑开，再碰人

assertions.claim: Grabbing with hands turns one casualty into two (pure self-interest rule).
assertions.cn_span: 直接上手拉，一个伤者就变成两个

assertions.claim: After separation from the source, no breathing → CPR per item 1; electric injury is no reason to fear touching.
assertions.cn_span: 脱离电源后没有呼吸的，立刻按第 1 条按压，别因为是电伤就不敢碰

assertions.claim: Downed high-voltage line and transformer equipment: don't handle it yourself, move away and wait for the power crew.
assertions.cn_span: 高压线落地、变电设备附近不自己处置，退远等电力部门断电
